records.context: the processing session's settings key-value mapping, recorded (hashed) in the model card. Its ``mixed_precision`` structured-data name turns on autocast for training, and its ``train_metrics_full_pass`` structured-data name chooses how the per-epoch training metrics are measured: off (the default), they are accumulated from the training batches themselves, in the mode and precision training uses, while the weights change through the epoch; on, the model is re-evaluated over the whole training loader after each epoch in eval mode and full precision, which costs one more pass over the data. Validation metrics are the same either way. When ``<src>/train`` does not exist, class counts for the loss come from the ``labels`` or ``targets`` attribute of the training dataset.

records.translation: stillingaorðabók keyrslunnar, skráð (tætt) í líkanspjaldið. Lykillinn ``mixed_precision`` í henni kveikir á autocast við þjálfun, og lykillinn ``train_metrics_full_pass`` velur hvernig þjálfunarmælingar hverrar þjálfunarlotu eru mældar: óvirkt (sjálfgefið) eru þær uppsafnaðar úr þjálfunarrununum sjálfum, í þeim ham og þeirri nákvæmni sem þjálfunin notar, meðan vigtirnar breytast í gegnum lotuna; virkt er líkanið metið aftur yfir alla þjálfunarhleðsluna eftir hverja þjálfunarlotu í matsham og fullri nákvæmni, sem kostar eina umferð í viðbót yfir gögnin. Staðfestingarmælingar eru þær sömu hvort sem er. Þegar ``<src>/train`` er ekki til kemur fjöldi í flokkum fyrir tapið úr eigindinni ``labels`` eða ``targets`` í þjálfunargagnasafninu.

records.context: metadata column naming each sample's batch, such as a laboratory microplate or an imaging week. Each fold's training side then drops every sample from a batch present in its validation side, so a held-out sample is never scored by a model that saw its batch (the not-same-compound-or-batch rule when ``group_column`` is a compound). The fold table gains ``held_out_batches``, ``n_train_excluded`` and ``train_classes_missing``.
